parsed.explanation: State-imposed universal exposure and state-directed targeting dominate: a morality law imposes a surveillance duty to prevent homosexuality, penal-code sodomy provisions plus a religious-law clause permit death, and documented enforcement includes raids, arbitrary detention, public flogging (1,110 flogged in 2025, escalating), physical and sexual abuse in custody, and security officials pursuing trans women systematically. The ruling movement's own members attack and expel LGBT people; leaked data is used to pursue gender-nonconforming individuals; visibly trans people are reported to face the gravest risks. ICC warrants cite persecution of the LGBTQ community. No protective machinery, no discrimination law, no documented remedy; border/facility questions are open but add nothing against this record. No documented systematic execution of trans visitors keeps this just above the absolute extreme.
